title: ソファの半分
theme: この子は広さではなく、私のとなりを選んでいた

slides.text:
一人暮らしなのに、
ソファが狭い理由
slides.scene: A two-seat sofa in a small apartment: the dog lies stretched out across exactly half of it, looking at the viewer; the other half is a small empty space.

slides.text:
このソファを買ったのは、
一人暮らしを始めた春
slides.scene: A spring-lit empty apartment with a brand-new sofa, cherry blossom branches visible outside the window. No dog yet.

slides.text:
大きすぎるかな、
と思っていた
slides.scene: The owner, seen from behind, sits alone on the far right end of the new sofa with lots of empty space to their left; there should be no dog on the sofa.

slides.text:
今は、ちょうど半分が
この子の場所だ
slides.scene: The dog lies on the right half of the sofa on its own blanket; the owner sits on the left half, seen from behind.

slides.text:
私が座ると、
必ずとなりに来る
slides.scene: The owner sits down on the sofa (seen from behind); the dog jumps up next to them from the floor.

slides.text:
わざわざ、
私の脚にくっついて
slides.scene: Close-up of the dog pressing its body against the owner's thigh on the sofa, though empty cushion space is on its other side.
slides.shot: close-up, empty cushion visible on the dog's far side

slides.text:
広いほうに行けばいいのに、
と思っていた
slides.scene: The owner's hand gestures toward the empty side of the sofa; the dog stays glued to the owner's leg, looking up.
slides.shot: close-up, hand pointing to the empty side

slides.text:
でもこの子は、
広さじゃなくて私を選んでいた
slides.scene: The dog curled up in the narrow gap right beside the owner's leg, ignoring the wide empty half of the sofa.
slides.shot: from above, the empty half clearly visible

slides.text:
テレビを消して、
となりをのぞきこむ
slides.scene: The owner, seen from behind, leans toward the dog beside them on the sofa; the TV on the wall is dark.

slides.text:
寝たふりをしながら、
しっぽだけ動いている
slides.scene: Close-up of the dog with eyes closed pretending to sleep while its tail wags.
slides.shot: close-up of the dog and tail

slides.text:
少しだけ、
脚をこの子のほうに寄せた
slides.scene: The owner's leg (grey pants) shifts closer so it touches the curled dog.

slides.text:
体温が、
じんわり伝わってくる
slides.scene: The owner's hand resting on the dog's warm back, soft evening light.

slides.text:
狭いソファも、
悪くない
slides.scene: The owner and the dog squeezed together on one half of the sofa, seen from behind, the other half empty.

slides.text:
むしろ、
この狭さがちょうどいい
slides.scene: The owner's arm around the dog on the sofa, the dog's chin on the owner's knee.

slides.text:
一人暮らしの部屋が、
二人の部屋になった
slides.scene: Wide view of the small apartment at night: the owner and the dog sit together on the sofa, seen from behind, warm lamp light; one mug on the coffee table and the dog's water bowl on the floor.
slides.shot: wide view from behind the sofa

slides.text:
いつまで、この狭さを
感じていられるだろう
slides.scene: The dog asleep peacefully on the sofa next to the owner's leg, calm night light.

slides.text:
だから、ソファを
買い替えるのはやめた
slides.scene: The owner's hand closes a furniture catalog on the coffee table; the dog sleeps on the sofa in the background.
slides.shot: close-up of hand and catalog, the dog behind

slides.text:
この狭さごと、
大事にしよう
slides.scene: The owner, seen from behind, hugs the dog on the sofa.

slides.text:
今夜も、半分こで
座ろう
slides.scene: The dog on its half of the sofa pats the cushion next to it with a paw, looking back over its shoulder at the owner who is standing behind the sofa.
slides.shot: from behind, the owner's legs behind the sofa

slides.text:
あなたの家では
あの子の特等席はどこですか？
slides.scene: Close-up of the dog curled on its favorite half of the sofa on its own blanket, content.

caption:
一人暮らしの部屋が、二人の部屋になった。
あなたの子の特等席は、どこですか？
youtube_title: 一人暮らしなのに、ソファが狭い理由
self_review: 別れの語は使わず、16枚目は時間の限りの示唆のみ。締めは『この狭さごと大事に』という前向きな決意。
